chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 350: The Secret Disciple — Tension Before Daofather’s Choice
chapter_meta_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly ends, but the true stakes begin. Ji Ning, Mu Northson, and Blackstone await Daofather Crimsonbright’s choice, while a mysterious Patriarch dispatches Floodcover Sage to retrieve a secret disciple. The Three Realms’ power shifts.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 350: The Secret Disciple
og_description: Ji Ning and the top three await Daofather Crimsonbright’s decision. Meanwhile, a Divine God arrives to retrieve a hundred-year-old secret disciple.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 350: The Secret Disciple
twitter_description: The top three await Daofather Crimsonbright’s verdict while Floodcover Sage is sent to claim a secret apprentice. The Three Realms’ politics are about to get messy.

lore_anchors.definition: A symbol in Daoist cosmology representing the Supreme Ultimate, the origin of Yin and Yang. In Xianxia, a Taiji Diagram hovering over a character is a visual sign of supreme cosmic authority, often marking a Daofather or a being of ultimate Dao enlightenment.

A Divine God (天神), one of the highest Fiendgod Body Refiners in the Three Realms. He is known for his overbearing, destructive personality and his terrifying combat power. His arrival is a major political event.
A True Immortal at Perfection, the pinnacle of Ki Refining within the Grand Xia Dynasty’s recognized hierarchy. They are vastly powerful but still subordinate to Daofathers.
The supreme Dao master who rules over the Crimsonbright Realm. He is the ultimate prize for the top three of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, as being his disciple is a life-changing cosmic promotion.
The ruler of the Grand Xia World, a major world within the Three Realms. He is a Celestial Immortal and a disciple of Daofather Crimsonbright, acting as the intermediary for the disciple selection.
A technique used to record and project visual scenes, equivalent to a magical video recording. The Xia Emperor uses it to send battle footage to Daofather Crimsonbright for evaluation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is the old black-haired man at the beginning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is a Daofather—likely Daofather Crimsonbright or another Patriarch of equivalent rank—as indicated by the Taiji Diagram hovering above him.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Slovenly True Immortal panic when Floodcover calls his name?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because Floodcover Sage is a terrifying Divine God whose sudden arrival and demand for “Zhang Qi” suggests either cosmic trouble or a life-changing event; the slovenly youth has no idea he is a Daofather’s secret disciple.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Will all three top contestants get a master?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes. The Grand Xia Emperor explicitly declares that one of the three will become Daofather Crimsonbright’s disciple, and the other two will be accepted by Pure Yang True Immortals.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Grand Xia Emperor treat Floodcover Sage with such respect?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because Floodcover is a Divine God (Chaos True God), a rank that places him far above even a Celestial Immortal emperor. In the Three Realms’ hierarchy, Divine Gods are second only to Daofathers.
